description: Spectrum TG45SC-E 223cc Petrol Scarifier and Aerator, 45cm, Electric Key Start
marketingText:
One machine covers two seasonal jobs: strip moss and thatch from a tired lawn in spring, then open compacted soil before autumn. The TG45SC-E arrives with a 45cm scarifier cassette fitted and an aerator cassette in the box, and you change between them by hand with no tools. Its 18 blades clear a 45cm width, suited to lawns up to 2,000m².

A 223cc four-stroke petrol engine drives the blades at 6hp (4.5kW), holding their bite through dense thatch rather than bogging down. Starting is done with a key - an on-board battery turns the engine over, and a recoil cord stays fitted as backup if that battery ever runs flat. A separate blade-engage lever stops and starts the cassette while the engine keeps running, so you can empty the 45-litre collector or lift over a path without restarting.

Six working heights set on a single lever, from -12mm for an aggressive thatch strip up to +10mm for a light surface pass, let you match the machine to the lawn and the season. A pressed steel deck keeps the blade shafts aligned under load, where thinner decks flex, and soft-grip handles fold down for storage above double ball-bearing wheels.
productFeatures1: Two machines in one: scarifier and aerator cassettes both included
productFeatures2: Electric key start fires the 223cc engine, recoil cord as backup
productFeatures3: Six working heights from -12mm to +10mm on one lever
whatIsInBox: Scarifier cassette (fitted), aerator cassette, 45-litre debris collector, operator manual

attrs.outdoorLivingSpecialFeature: Electric key start with recoil backup; 2-in-1 interchangeable scarifier and aerator cassettes
